one_line: All-in-one CRM platform (marketing, sales, service, CMS) with a broad REST API and date-based versioning.
auth_notes: OAuth2 for public/private apps with scoped tokens; private apps provide self-serve personal access keys (API keys) created in the HubSpot account. New API versioning is date-based (e.g. /crm/objects/2026-03/contacts) at api.hubapi.com.
self_serve_notes: Free CRM tier exists; private app tokens are fully self-serve for any HubSpot account, no approval needed.

api_surface.breadth_estimate: Hundreds of endpoints across CRM objects, marketing, sales, service, CMS, events, and messaging APIs
api_surface.webhook_note: Webhook subscriptions supported for CRM object and event streams (contacts, companies, deals, etc.)

existing_mcp.note: Official HubSpot MCP server exists (github.com/HubSpot/hubspot-mcp); multiple community servers too

evidence.note: Fetched text confirmed API root, date-based versioning (2026-03) and endpoints; auth details from knowledge

agent_notes: Fetched page confirmed versioning model only; OAuth/private-app token and MCP details from knowledge. Solid, low-friction integration target.
